purpose: Pre-full-run measurement and inference freeze; no scientific outcome analysis.

estimand.population: 1500 frozen utterances, 300 in each frozen T/A/V pattern
estimand.natural_distribution_sensitivity: tuple post-stratification only where panel support is positive; unsupported tuples are non-identifiable and are never imputed.

frozen_readability.Readable_T: parsed T_ONLY label equals source y_T
frozen_readability.Readable_A: parsed A_ONLY label equals source y_A
frozen_readability.Readable_V: parsed V_ONLY label equals source y_V
frozen_readability.DualReadable_pair: both corresponding unimodal Readable indicators are true

measurement_extension.inference_stage: same fixed 18 gate records; greedy generation and parser first; then candidate scoring on same prompt/media inputs
measurement_extension.candidate_order: frozen per utterance and identical across all arms; do not rotate or alter

tokenizer_audit.assistant_generation_prefix: actual rendered V1 prompt with add_generation_prompt=True

scoring.candidate_tokenization: tokenize exact canonical lowercase string appended to the rendered assistant-generation prefix; require prefix token IDs unchanged; retain per-candidate continuation token IDs and counts.
scoring.score: sum of teacher-forced token log probabilities for the exact candidate continuation; also report mean token log probability.
scoring.primary_probability: softmax(mean token log probability across the seven labels).
scoring.sensitivity_probability: softmax(sum token log probability across the seven labels).
scoring.greedy_label: unchanged V1.1 greedy generation plus frozen parser; remains the sole input to frozen readability.
scoring.uncertainty: normalized entropy H/log(7), top-1, top-2, top-1 minus top-2 probability margin, source-label probability, greedy/parser-label versus score argmax agreement.
scoring.not_allowed: No score/probability is used to change generation, parse labels, readability, sample inclusion, or scientific outcomes.

annotation_uncertainty.source: official selected-panel annotation JSON A-E entries, emotion votes and Confidence_degree
annotation_uncertainty.outputs: raw per-annotator categorical votes and confidence values plus vote entropy, agreement fractions, and confidence summaries
annotation_uncertainty.role: descriptive annotation metadata only; not sample selection, readability, primary pairwise analysis, or transfer fitting
annotation_uncertainty.y_M: if present, descriptive metadata only; no primary target use

pairwise_spec.population: pair-specific source-label conflict AND frozen DualReadable; same-panel consistent AND DualReadable controls
pairwise_spec.arms: paired reciprocal evidence orders per utterance; never independent samples
primary_outcomes: side-choice among the two source labels

pairwise_to_trimodal.edge_rule: Conflict-only directed edge for a source-side choice; OTHER/PARSE_FAIL is UNRESOLVED. A source-label-consistent pair has relation SAME_LABEL and does not create a directed edge.
pairwise_to_trimodal.stable_edge: Both reciprocal pair orders select the same side; opposite choices are ORDER_SENSITIVE and remain order-specific.
pairwise_to_trimodal.stable_prediction: TWO_VS_ONE: the two cross-group conflict edges must each be stable and agree on the shared-versus-minority winner; the shared/shared pair is SAME_LABEL. ALL_DIFFERENT: all three conflict edges must be stable and form a transitive total order with a unique top label. Order-sensitive, cyclic, or unresolved cases yield UNRESOLVED.
pairwise_to_trimodal.order_conditioned_prediction: For each exact tri-modal order, use only pairwise outputs matching each conflict pair relative order. TWO_VS_ONE requires both cross-group conflict edges to agree; ALL_DIFFERENT requires all three edges to form a transitive tournament with a unique Condorcet winner. Any disagreement, cycle, or unresolved edge yields UNRESOLVED.
pairwise_to_trimodal.TWO_VS_ONE: The two induced conflict edges between the shared-label group and minority-label group must both favor the same group; the consistent shared/shared pair is SAME_LABEL. Disagreement, unresolved edge, or cycle yields UNRESOLVED.
pairwise_to_trimodal.ALL_DIFFERENT: Unique Condorcet winner if one label beats both alternatives and the remaining edge is consistent; directed cycle or any unresolved edge yields UNRESOLVED.
primary_metrics: overall eligible correct rate counting unresolved as not resolved/correct
pairwise_to_trimodal.secondary_learned_composition: If added in a later explicitly scoped analysis, use speaker-grouped cross-fitting; hold out each evaluation fold and prohibit its tri-modal outputs from fitting or tuning; no full-sample fit evaluated on the same tri-modal outputs.

cross_regime_transfer.target_use: held-out zero-refit only; no target fitting/tuning/scaler fitting
unsupported: EmotionTalk V-T has no target dataset in the declared mapping
EmoMM remains held-out only for a later specified mapping
cross_regime_transfer.baseline: constant source-modality-preference prediction, fixed from source; no target fit
cross_regime_transfer.interpretation: all claims conditional on frozen pair-specific DualReadable population

compute.readability_rates: unknown until Phase 1; do not assume
